visual_review.text: Visually matches original Russian title and complete rules text, including original three-line rule layout.
visual_review.coins: Three gold coins in original left column.
visual_review.medallion: Purple/pink special-district medallion retained; small ornament details are regenerated.
visual_review.composition: Main houses, street curve, spire, silhouettes and layout remain recognizable and closely aligned.
visual_review.limitations: Higher contrast and more defined roof tiles, stone paving and cloud texture than original; microdetails are synthesized and exact object-by-object fidelity cannot be guaranteed.
